description: This Java source file contains unit tests for the ObsValidator class in the OpenMRS project. The tests validate various aspects of Obs validation such as field correctness, range checking, interpretation setting, and error handling, specifically in the context of medical observation data.

classes.name: ObsValidatorTest
classes.description: Test class for validating the functionality of the ObsValidator class, including validation rules, range checks, interpretations, and error handling.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfPersonIdIsNull
methods.description: Tests that validation fails if the Person ID in Obs is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfObsDatetimeIsNull
methods.description: Tests that validation fails if the Obs datetime is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfParentObsHasValues
methods.description: Ensures validation fails if parent Obs has existing values set.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfObsHasNoValuesAndNotParent
methods.description: Checks that validation fails when Obs has no values and is not a parent.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfConceptIsNull
methods.description: Tests validation failure when the concept in Obs is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfConceptDatatypeIsBooleanAndValueBooleanIsNull
methods.description: Checks for validation failure when Boolean datatype concept has null value.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfConceptDatatypeIsCodedAndValueCodedIsNull
methods.description: Checks for validation failure when Coded datatype concept has null coded value.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfConceptDatatypeIsDateAndValueDatetimeIsNull
methods.description: Ensures validation failure if Date datatype concept has null date value.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfConceptDatatypeIsNumericAndValueNumericIsNull
methods.description: Verifies validation fails if Numeric datatype concept has null numeric value.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfConceptDatatypeIsTextAndValueTextIsNull
methods.description: Checks validation failure when Text datatype concept has null text value.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfObsAncestorsContainsObs
methods.description: Test that validation fails if the Obs group contains itself, preventing circular references.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfAllValuesPresent
methods.description: Verifies that validation passes when all required values are properly set.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfValueTextIsGreaterThanTheMaximumLength
methods.description: Checks that validation errors occur if valueText exceeds length limit.

methods.name: validate_shouldRejectAnInvalidConceptAndDrugCombination
methods.description: Ensures validation fails if the drug and concept combination is inconsistent.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfAnswerConceptAndConceptOfValueDrugMatch
methods.description: Test for successful validation when answer concept matches the concept of the drug value.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfFieldLengthsAreCorrect
methods.description: Checks that validation passes when string fields have acceptable lengths.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfFieldLengthsAreNotCorrect
methods.description: Checks that validation errors are raised for overly long string fields.

methods.name: supports_shouldSupportObsClass
methods.description: Confirms that ObsValidator indicates support for the Obs class.

methods.name: validate_shouldNotValidateIfObsIsVoided
methods.description: Tests that validation skips or passes for a voided Obs.

methods.name: validate_shouldNotValidateAVoidedChildObs
methods.description: Ensures validation bypasses child Obs if that Obs is voided.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailForANullObject
methods.description: Confirms that passing null to validate throws an APIException.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfValueTextIsLessThanTheMaximumLength
methods.description: Checks validation passes with acceptable length of valueText.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfObsValueExceedsHiAbsolute
methods.description: Verifies validation error when Obs value exceeds absolute high range.

methods.name: shouldPickTheRightObsGivenTwoObsWithTheSameConcept
methods.description: Ensures the correct Obs is selected when multiple exist with the same concept.

methods.name: shouldSetInterpretationToHighIfObsValueIsAboveHiNormalAndLessThanHighCritical
methods.description: Checks that interpretation is set to HIGH when value exceeds HiNormal but below HighCritical.

methods.name: shouldSetInterpretationToCriticallyHighIfObsValueIsAboveHighCritical
methods.description: Tests interpretation is CRITICALLY_HIGH if value is above HighCritical.

methods.name: shouldSetInterpretationToCriticallyHighIfObsValueIsEqualToHighCritical
methods.description: Ensures interpretation is CRITICALLY_HIGH when value equals HighCritical.

methods.name: shouldSetInterpretationToCriticallyLowIfObsValueIsEqualToLowCritical
methods.description: Checks for CRITICALLY_LOW interpretation when value equals LowCritical.

methods.name: shouldSetInterpretationToNormalIfObsValueIsWithinNormalRange
methods.description: Validates interpretation is NORMAL when value is within range.

methods.name: shouldSetInterpretationToCriticalLowIfObsValueIsBelowLowCritical
methods.description: Ensures interpretation is CRITICALLY_LOW if value is below LowCritical.
